header.function_name: Driver Order Sync - HiveMQ (TC-PBR to Driver APK)

items.ref: UISS: Func Flow step 1-2, Log no.1, Data Map blk 1, Data Map blk 9

detail: Process ID: (Process ID of the run)

expected: Log no.1 (Info): 'Driver Order Sync id started. Trigger : EVENT.'
STATUS PROCESSING; queue row of ORD-01.
execution: Assign truck B 1234 DN to order ORD-01 on Planning Truck Assignment (writes TB_T_DRIVER_SYNC_QUEUE); the sync job runs (trigger TBD).

items.ref: UISS: 4.3, 4.5, Log no.13, Data Map blk 2, Data Map blk 5, Data Map blk 6, Data Map blk 7

detail: Process ID: (Process ID of the run)

procedure: Check TB_R_DRIVER_ORDER, outbox, queue (SQL TD-11); MQTT client on the topic.
expected: Log no.13 (Debug): 'Message <MSG_ID> (<ACTION> <CYCLE_ORDER_NO>) published to <TOPIC>.'
TB_R_DRIVER_ORDER rows per cycle (plate, driver, route, lat / lng); outbox STATUS PUBLISHED; queue DONE; message received on the topic.
execution: Assign truck B 1234 DN to order ORD-01 on Planning Truck Assignment (writes TB_T_DRIVER_SYNC_QUEUE); the sync job runs (trigger TBD).

items.ref: UISS: 4.3, Data Map blk 3, Data Map blk 4
expected: Old plate rows ACTIVE_FLAG N (REMOVE), new plate rows ADD; one message per change.
execution: Change Truck of ORD-01 to B 5678 DN; run the job.

items.ref: UISS: Log no.16, Data Map blk 8

detail: Process ID: (Process ID of the run)

expected: Log no.16 (Info): 'Driver Order Sync <SYNC_ID> finished. Added <n>, updated <n>, removed <n>, skipped <n>, error <n>, published <n>, publish error <n>.'
execution: Assign truck B 1234 DN to order ORD-01 on Planning Truck Assignment (writes TB_T_DRIVER_SYNC_QUEUE); the sync job runs (trigger TBD).

detail: Process ID: (Process ID of the run)

expected: Log no.5 (Info): 'Driver Order Sync <SYNC_ID>: no event to process.'
Log no.7 (Info): 'Order <ORDER_NO> has no active truck assignment, not sent to driver.'
execution: Run the job with an empty queue; then queue an order without active truck.

detail: Process ID: (Process ID of the run)

expected: Log no.2 (Warning): 'Driver Order Sync skipped: run <SYNC_ID> still processing.'
execution: Start a second run while the first is running.

abnormal.ref: UISS: Log no.3, Log no.4, Log no.11

detail: Process ID: (Process ID of the run)

expected: Log no.3 (Critical): 'Database cannot be connected.'
Log no.4 (Critical): 'Sync parameter <PARAM_CD> not found in System Master.'
Log no.11 (Critical): 'Cannot connect to HiveMQ broker <HOST>:<PORT> (<REASON>).'
execution: Stop DB; remove the sync parameter in TB_M_SYSTEM; stop the HiveMQ broker (one per run).

abnormal.ref: UISS: 4.2, Log no.6, Log no.8, Log no.9, Log no.10

detail: Process ID: (Process ID of the run)

expected: Log no.6 (Error): 'Order <ORDER_NO> not found for queue <QUEUE_ID>.'
Log no.8 (Error): 'Truck <PLATE_NO> of order <ORDER_NO> is not active in Truck Master.'
Log no.9 (Warning): 'No active driver on truck <PLATE_NO> for order <ORDER_NO>.'
Log no.10 (Error): 'Mandatory field <FIELD> empty on order <ORDER_NO>.'
execution: Queue an unknown order; an order with inactive truck; a truck without driver; an order without From location.

abnormal.case: Publish / save errors and retry limit
abnormal.ref: UISS: Log no.12, Log no.14, Log no.15

detail: Process ID: (Process ID of the run)

expected: Log no.12 (Error): 'Publish of <MSG_ID> to topic <TOPIC> failed: <REASON>.'
Log no.14 (Error): 'Failed to save driver order <CYCLE_ORDER_NO>: <DB_ERROR>.'
Log no.15 (Error): 'Queue <QUEUE_ID> of order <ORDER_NO> failed <ATTEMPT> times.'
execution: Deny the topic ACL; lock TB_R_DRIVER_ORDER; repeat failure up to the attempt limit (TBD).

detail: Process ID: (Process ID of the run)

expected: Log no.17 (Critical): 'Driver Order Sync <SYNC_ID> stopped: <ERROR>.'

precondition: Order ORD-01 with 2 cycles; trucks B 1234 DN, B 5678 DN with active drivers; HiveMQ test broker.
Proposed tables TB_T_DRIVER_SYNC_QUEUE, TB_R_DRIVER_ORDER, TB_R_DRIVER_MQ_OUTBOX, TB_R_DRIVER_SYNC_LOG (not in ELIPS) created.
